why: The degree of dissociation varies in inverse proportion to the limiting molar conductivity, and the degree of dissociation varies in direct proportion to the molar conductivity, so the factor is $4^{-1} \times 3^{1}$ = 0.75. The other options come from common slips: 12 if you ignored the powers in the relation; 1.33 if you turned the ratio upside down; 0.25 if you changed only the limiting molar conductivity.
